accept.specs:
spec fn ref_pre(a: &[i64]) -> bool { forall|k: usize| k < a.len() ==> -1000 <= #[trigger] a[k] && a[k] <= 1000 }
spec fn ref_post(a: &[i64], r: i64) -> bool { 0 <= r && (forall|k: usize| k + 1 < a.len() ==> a[k + 1] - #[trigger] a[k] <= r && a[k] - a[k + 1] <= r) }

also_check.signature: fn abs_diff(a: i64, b: i64) -> (r: i64)
